project.name: LocalHelm
project.description: Status for the products you ship. A named fleet board for git, npm, and dependents. Generic JSON export; no shop-specific shelf.

exitCriteriaMet: Major decisions recorded in workflow_tracking.json decisions[]

notes.text: M1 CLI spine: scan, enroll/unenroll --apply, status, deps, JSON. Tests and tsc pass.
M2: bump, fetch, pull --ff-only, export write, job.lock, SvelteKit app/ + localhelm serve on 127.0.0.1:4321.
M3: ready list + cascade plan/apply at ^V. link:/file: skipped explicitly. Commit on apply default on. Dashboard Ready + Cascade panels.
Selected origin push (D18): named ids on apply, dashboard confirm lists remotes, never --force.
Named publish (D19): bump+commit if local is on npm, push if origin is behind, then npm publish. Never --force.
Activity persists at .localhelm/activity.json (D23). Refresh reloads; Clear deletes the file.
Ports tab (D24): LocalBerth plugin hosts leases + observed. Not under Sites. Claim/release stay on localberth.
Dashboard UX (D20): Today / Fleet / Sites tabs. Combined needs-you is the default. Lighter panels. FilePress site vs fleet package labeled when names match.
Dashboard writes (D21): one action button plans, then a confirm modal shows what will run. Close if nothing to do. CLI still needs --apply.
Bulk selection (D22): Fleet checkboxes drive bump, push, and remove. Sites checkboxes drive plugin jobs. Select-all in the header.
URL selection state (D34): tab, ports, activity, fleet/sites CSV via replaceState — Exec Foundry pattern.
Ports Start/Stop (D35): LocalBerth owns process lifecycle; LocalHelm hosts plan/apply. ?leases= CSV.
Confirm modal dismisses on Confirm. LocalBerth bridge exits after start/stop JSON so spawnSync returns.
Draft cheap-surfaces spec (docs/specs/cheap-surfaces.md). Twin in localberth. Not scheduled.
H1 cheap surfaces: family stacks, look cards, PORT/HOST on Ports confirm (d36).
H2–H5 brief, archive, family start/stop, save-guess. Today Ports titled Stacks / Down lists.
Quiet sites, cross-walk chips, copy, activity links, recipe health + guess-all, Tippy labels.
Attention UX (d38): Fleet needs you is the row write; Sites/Ports notes in ? tip; Ports actions one line; labeled stacks.
Bump apply commits package.json (d39). Fleet project cell is one line.
Scoped status refresh (d40): row/checked ids via ?ids=; write jobs reload only those rows.
Publish confirm omits auth setup copy when npm whoami works (d41).
Bulk apply shows N of M · id (d42). Plugin/push/publish/pull/fetch run one row at a time.
Sites table: engine version + Sync engine <target> only when needed (d43). Site cell one line.
Table cleanup (d44): Fleet local+npm → version; Ports hide listening/log/health/firewall; Sites hide headers/ship; one-line name cells.
Cut version gated on origin commits since last npm version (d45).

decisions.decision: Product archetype: public local operator CLI + optional loopback dashboard; FilePress explainer site later.
decisions.rationale: Others will install localhelm. Not an internal-only tool and not a one-shot.

decisions.decision: House stack: TypeScript, ESM, pnpm, Node 22+, no accounts, no telemetry.
decisions.rationale: Genesis house defaults. Matches LocalBerth / IngotVault. Local-only product.

decisions.decision: License Apache-2.0.
decisions.rationale: Confirmed 2026-08-20. Matches IngotVault, LocalBerth, ForgeTrail.

decisions.decision: No publish action and no git push in v1. Operator publishes. Agents never run npm/pnpm publish. Publish may be a later option; never the first ship. Push is a later milestone with harsh confirm. Never force-push.
decisions.rationale: Confirmed 2026-08-20. Eligible badge only at first. Future publish/push are explicit later work. Push lifted 2026-08-21 as d18.

decisions.decision: CLI name localhelm. Never helm. Public name LocalHelm.
decisions.rationale: Kubernetes Helm / TaskHelm / iamgp/helm collisions. localhelm@0.0.0 published 2026-08-20.

decisions.decision: Compose with IngotVault, LocalBerth, and FilePress siblings. Do not reimplement spare remotes, port leases, or _headers merge.
decisions.rationale: Those tools already own those guarantees. LocalHelm is the fleet board.

decisions.decision: State persistence is local files only: fleet manifest + gitignored job state. No PocketBase, no auth.
decisions.rationale: Single-operator machine tool. Intake §7 A-local. Dashboard binds 127.0.0.1.

decisions.decision: No LLM-produced product content. Inventory is read from disk, git, and npm.
decisions.rationale: Genesis non-goal: no LLM choosing versions, commit messages, or which dependents to skip.

decisions.decision: No product-specific shelf in LocalHelm. Do not read or write catalyst-forge projects.js or any other shop catalog. Export generic JSON; consumers (including CF later) adapt.
decisions.rationale: localhelm is a public package. Baking a CF shelf would make every other shop a second-class citizen and couple the CLI to one marketing file.
alternatives_considered: catalogName as a first-class CF card

decisions.decision: Public site is localhelm.dev with a FilePress explainer plus /docs. Not a v1 CLI blocker.
decisions.rationale: Domain secured 2026-08-20. Operator asked for /docs on the FilePress site.

decisions.decision: Enroll scans one or more folders and the operator checks/confirms which rows to enroll. Nothing written until confirm.
decisions.rationale: A named fleet is chosen, not auto-enrolled from a disk walk.
alternatives_considered: Print-only discover plus one-path enroll only

decisions.decision: Commit on apply, default on for cascade and export write. No attribution trailers.
decisions.rationale: Confirmed 2026-08-20. Operator said yes commit.

decisions.decision: Cascade writes ^V. Manifest workspaceRoot is ".". Optional group on rows. JSON inventory in M1; MCP in M4.
decisions.rationale: Confirmed 2026-08-20.

decisions.decision: CLI + SvelteKit dashboard in app/. Shared library and CLI in src/. FilePress site/ with /docs.
decisions.rationale: Confirmed 2026-08-20. Not a tiny static page.

decisions.decision: Scan reads gitignore-style .localhelmignore (walk-up) and optional ~/.localhelm/ignore. Hard skips remain node_modules, dot-dirs, __*.
decisions.rationale: Operator asked for a folder ignore file so sandbox/noise is not proposed.

decisions.decision: Cascade retargets registry pins to ^V (published npm only). link:/file: rows skip with an explicit reason instead of silently converting. Apply commits those package.json + lockfile paths by default (--no-commit to skip). One publisher per job; dependents are not published.
decisions.rationale: Locked brief D12–D14 plus genesis 6.2–6.6. FilePress already taught us not to treat a leftover link: as current.
alternatives_considered: Cascade the next wave in the same job

decisions.decision: FilePress-specific jobs (discover content sites, link:→registry, _headers merge, pnpm ship) are a plugin loaded from the enrolled filepress checkout (localhelm.plugin.mjs). LocalHelm core stays generic and does not reimplement header merge or engine pin rewrite.
decisions.rationale: Operator wanted one window (absorb C) without baking FilePress into the public localhelm package. Compose: host here, library stays in FilePress.
alternatives_considered: Keep a second siblings dashboard only

decisions.decision: Selected origin push is in. CLI apply requires named project ids. Dashboard apply shows a confirm listing each id, branch, ahead count, and origin URL. git push origin <branch> only. Never --force / --force-with-lease. Never the IngotVault backup remote. Skip dirty, detached, diverged, not-ahead, no-upstream. Publish stays out of the tool.
decisions.rationale: Operator 2026-08-21: opening each folder to push is the remaining pain. Genesis 4.6 / 4.8 already specified named push + harsh confirm. Lifts D13.

decisions.decision: Named publish is in. Plan shows bump+commit (only if local is already on npm), push (only if origin is behind or a bump will make it so), then npm publish --access public. Apply requires named project ids and a dashboard confirm listing the registry version. Never --force. OTP is optional --otp / dashboard field. Agents still do not apply publish unless the operator asked.
decisions.rationale: Operator 2026-08-23: publishing by hand (bump, commit, push, npm publish) had become a chore. Lifts D4's 'future option'.

decisions.decision: Dashboard is tabbed: Today (default combined needs-you + FilePress snapshot + activity), Fleet (full table, bump, enroll), Sites (plugin board). Ship and cascade actions live on the cards that need them, not a second sidebar list. FilePress rows that share a fleet id are labeled as sites.
decisions.rationale: Operator 2026-08-23: localhelm and localberth appeared twice on one screen; the all-black board was hard to follow. Tabs plus lighter panels keep the same plan/apply jobs without repeating every package.
alternatives_considered: Merge FilePress site rows into fleet

decisions.decision: Dashboard writes are one button. Click Push / Publish / Sync / Bump / Pull / Cascade / Enroll / Export; the app runs the plan, the modal lists what will happen, Confirm applies. If the plan is empty the modal says so and only Close is offered. CLI stays plan-then--apply. FilePress sibling Apply/Ship now plan first, then confirm.
decisions.rationale: Operator 2026-08-23: Plan then Write pairs felt like extra steps with little benefit. Safety stays in the modal, not a second button.
alternatives_considered: Apply immediately without a plan modal

decisions.decision: Fleet and Sites checkboxes are a selection for bulk writes, not only unenroll. Fleet: Bump, Push, Remove on the checked ids. Sites: each plugin action on the checked sites. Select-all lives in the table header. Empty selection disables the bulk buttons. Each click still plans, then confirms. Publish stays on Today.
decisions.rationale: Operator 2026-08-23: checkboxes were only useful for multi-delete; the same selection should cover the other row actions, including FilePress sites.

decisions.decision: Dashboard Activity is persisted at <workspaceRoot>/.localhelm/activity.json (gitignored, same folder as job.lock). Newest first, cap 200. Load on refresh, append on each note, Clear deletes the file. No fleet required — fall back to operator cwd.
decisions.rationale: Operator 2026-08-23: the drawer was in-memory only, so a refresh wiped the plan/write history.

decisions.decision: LocalBerth is a plugin on a Ports tab, not under Sites. The plugin lives in the localberth checkout and returns the same leases + observed board the LocalBerth dashboard shows, plus Open links. Claim, release, and firewall stay on the localberth CLI. localberth serve remains. Plugin boards may set tab: ports|sites (default sites).
decisions.rationale: Operator 2026-08-23: parity with the current LocalBerth dashboard, and the tab should be called Ports.

decisions.decision: Today rows have one gold write matching the need (unpublished → Publish, git ahead → Push, dependents behind → Write pins). Cut version is a quiet extra. Publish OTP and npm login live in the confirm modal, not on the Today list. Fleet per-row Push/Publish removed; checkboxes + toolbar cover those. Header reads collapse to Refresh and Fetch remotes.
decisions.rationale: Operator 2026-08-23: Today stacked patch + Publish + Push + OTP on every card and the header had three overlapping refresh buttons.
alternatives_considered: Keep every write gold on each card
Move all writes to Fleet only

decisions.decision: Today must not say the fleet is quiet or that there is no fleet until /api/status finishes. npm whoami rides with status, is shown as a chip, and a successful login is kept if a later whoami flakes.
decisions.rationale: Operator 2026-08-23: All quiet rendered while Working: reading status, and npm was already signed in from earlier in the session.

decisions.decision: Activity is a header icon-button that toggles the drawer (Lucide scroll-text, unseen badge), not a fifth tab. Dashboard icons are Iconify Lucide, bundled offline via @iconify-json/lucide, with one IconButton primitive.
decisions.rationale: Operator 2026-08-23: show/hide activity as a tab does not make sense; follow Exec Foundry icon usage.
alternatives_considered: Keep Activity in the tab strip as an icon tab

decisions.decision: Push plans ahead commits even when the working tree is dirty. Uncommitted files stay local. Pull, publish, and cascade still skip dirty trees.
decisions.rationale: Operator 2026-08-23: aibreze showed 2 to push then the modal said nothing to push because the plan treated dirty as a skip. git push does not require a clean tree.
alternatives_considered: Keep skip-dirty and change the badge

decisions.decision: Today and Fleet only offer a write when the matching plan would act. Shared gates live in writeGate.ts (whyNotPush, whyNotPublish, writableCascadeCount). Publish stays skip-dirty; Write pins is not offered for link:/file: or dirty consumers.
decisions.rationale: Operator 2026-08-23: after the dirty-push skip, asked if other rules were similarly wrong. The remaining skips were correct; the UI was offering writes the plan refused.
alternatives_considered: Keep the buttons and rely on the empty modal

decisions.decision: Today shows the ahead count once (on Push N). gitSummary drops ahead/behind. Failed push apply sets a banner from plainGitError. LocalHelm does not rewrite git@ remotes to HTTPS.
decisions.rationale: Operator 2026-08-23: ember-dossier push failed with Permission denied (publickey), and Today repeated 28 to push three times. Same SSH gap as session 4; HTTPS probe to that repo works.

decisions.decision: Fleet origin remotes use HTTPS. Operator confirmed. Rewrote git@github.com and git@github-acmegeek origins. Left backup (D:/git-mirrors) and forgetrail archive remotes. anticonfab has no remotes.
decisions.rationale: Operator 2026-08-23: I'm fine with https on all. SSH agent is unavailable in this process; HTTPS ls-remote succeeded on every origin that exists.
alternatives_considered: Keep SSH and start an agent

decisions.decision: Sites get a Land write: engine package (filepress) pull/push/publish if needed, companion package (strip -site or exact id), then FilePress Sync → Push → Ship. One confirm, stop on first failure. CLI localhelm land <site-id> [--apply]. Publish only when unpublished-ahead.
decisions.rationale: Operator 2026-08-23: wanted a magic full-sync for a site (B+C: matching fleet package + engine). Name Land.

decisions.decision: Land skips ship when the site HEAD+dirty fingerprint matches the last successful ship (stored in .localhelm/land-ships.json). FilePress exposes shipFingerprint and a one-pass plan --action land. Land status only loads engine+companion ids.
decisions.rationale: Operator 2026-08-23: Land modal was slow; after Ship, Land offered Ship again with nothing new.
alternatives_considered: Ask FilePress to track last deploy itself

decisions.decision: Dashboard selection state lives in the URL via replaceState (Exec Foundry pattern): tab, ports, activity=1, fleet CSV, sites CSV. Defaults omitted. npmUser stays in sessionStorage. One-time migrate from old sessionStorage tab/pane/activity keys.
decisions.rationale: Operator 2026-08-23: tabs/subtabs and other selection state should be preserved in the URL like Exec Foundry.

decisions.decision: Ports Start/Stop is hosted only: LocalBerth owns start/stop + lease recipe (default pnpm serve, detached). LocalHelm plan/apply buttons and ?leases= CSV. Observed-only rows stay read-only. Claim/release stay on the localberth CLI. Fleet dashboards expose pnpm serve as the house entry.
decisions.rationale: Operator 2026-08-24: start/stop fleet apps that are not running, via LocalBerth as a LocalHelm plugin. Do not guess npm run dev.

decisions.decision: Family is inferred from lease/fleet ids (strip one -site/-api, fold hyphens). Today shows look cards that are not writes. Ports Start confirm prints PORT and HOST from the LocalBerth plan. LocalHelm does not spawn or read ~/.localberth logs itself.
decisions.rationale: Operator picked cheap-surfaces H1. Facts already on the plugin board were not on Today. file vs filepress must not collide.
alternatives_considered: Exec localberth doctor from the dashboard

decisions.decision: H2–H5: localhelm brief is clipboard markdown. Archive hides fleet ids in .localhelm/archive.json (folder stays). Ports hosts park/unpark and family start/stop; row Start only when down, Stop only when up. Today Ports is one column with titled Stacks and Down or conflicted lists.
decisions.rationale: Operator 2026-08-25: two untitled Today Ports scrolls, Start shown while listening, then A/B/C (brief, archive/park, family + save-guess).

decisions.decision: Fleet needs you is the row write (Push N, Publish version, Write pins) when the plan would write. Blockers stay as pills. Sites/Ports long notes live in a ? tip. Ports stack chips check a family; they do not start. Cross-walk chips are labeled also on and use tab names.
decisions.rationale: Operator 2026-08-25: row actions wrapping, unclear family chips, Sites wall of text, inert needs-you pills, tab overlap.

decisions.decision: Bump apply writes package.json and commits that file (Helm: bump <pkg> to <ver>.). Other dirty files stay local. No tag, no push, no publish. Push stays its own confirm.
decisions.rationale: Operator 2026-08-26: Fleet Bump left filepress dirty and required extra steps.

decisions.decision: Status can refresh a subset of fleet ids (API ?ids=, CLI argv, dashboard row/checked). Scoped runs skip Sites/Ports/activity/archive. Bump/push/publish/cascade reload only written ids. Header Refresh remains the full fleet.
decisions.rationale: Operator 2026-08-26: waiting on a whole-fleet refresh after a single-row write is too slow.
alternatives_considered: Also fetch remotes on row refresh

decisions.decision: Publish/land confirm shows the localhelm auth setup paragraph only when npm whoami fails. A working user is already authenticated via ~/.npmrc; keep the logged-in line and optional OTP.
decisions.rationale: Operator 2026-08-26: already set a local auth token; the setup lecture on Publish getfilepress@0.1.10 was noise.

decisions.decision: Bulk writes apply one id at a time and set busy to 'verb N of M · id'. Confirm stays open and shows the same label. Covers plugin jobs (Sync engine / selection), bump, push, publish, pull, and fetch remotes.
decisions.rationale: Operator 2026-08-26: 18-site engine sync looked stuck because one request had no progress.

decisions.decision: FilePress Sites table hides pin/locked/update and shows one engine (locked) version. Row Sync engine <target> only when the site is behind or headers need merge. Site cell is one line (id + chips).
decisions.rationale: Operator 2026-08-26: three version columns plus a Sync button, and a three-line site cell.

decisions.decision: Same table density as Sites: Fleet shows one version (npm note only when it differs or is missing). Ports leases hide listening, log, health, and skipped firewall; recipe shows the command or no-recipe plus a firewall that needs work. Sites also hide headers and ship columns. Name cells stay one line (compact chips; no repeated npm name; no FilePress disclaimer on Today cards). Per-row Bump, Park, Push, and Ship stay — those writes are optional or lack a reliable 'needed' signal.
decisions.rationale: Operator 2026-08-26: review the other tables for the same column collapse, one-line cells, and buttons only when they apply.
alternatives_considered: Merge Fleet git into needs you

decisions.decision: Cut version (and a publish plan that would bump) only when origin has commits after the last published version. Count is git rev-list from v-tag or the last package.json version bump to origin/<branch>. 0 → skip 'nothing to cut'. Unknown (null) does not skip. Unpublished-ahead still publishes without this gate.
decisions.rationale: Operator 2026-08-26: keep Cut version only when there is actually a version to cut — pushed work since the last publish.
alternatives_considered: npm view time vs git date

gotchas.issue: findManifest walked forever on Windows: toPosix flipped Z: and Z:/ so parent never equaled dir. enroll appeared to hang.
gotchas.resolution: Normalize drive roots as X:/, stop walk-up at isFsRoot, cap iterations at 64.

gotchas.issue: A failed git fetch (SSH publickey denied on git@github.com remotes) replaced the whole git cell with a stack of stderr, so dirty/ahead/behind and the unpublished-ahead signal were invisible for localhelm and localberth.
gotchas.resolution: readGit records fetchError and keeps reading local status; the dashboard shows local truth plus a short 'remote not read' note, and the CLI adds a remote-unreadable note.

gotchas.issue: Leftover vite dev process kept port 4321 bound after the parent serve was killed, so the next localhelm serve failed with strictPort.
gotchas.resolution: Kill the whole tree (taskkill /T) or check the port owner before reserving; a LocalBerth lease avoids the collision.

gotchas.issue: Dashboard git push to git@github.com failed: Permission denied (publickey). This process has no ssh-agent. HTTPS to the same repo works (localhelm and localberth already use HTTPS).
gotchas.resolution: Show a banner (origin rejected the SSH key). Do not rewrite remotes unless asked. Operator can switch origin to HTTPS or start serve from a shell where ssh-add -l lists a GitHub key.

gotchas.issue: npmjs.com resolves README images from the published tarball. A logo at site/static/logo.png 404s unless that path is in package.json files.
gotchas.resolution: Ship site/static/logo.png in files, same pattern as LocalBerth.
